name: Coredash MCP
summary: Connect Koris to Coredash MCP server via Streamable HTTP for personal dashboard tools.
description:
[CoreDash](https://github.com/guilhermesalviano/coredash) is a lightweight, self-hosted personal dashboard for personal automation, system monitoring, habit tracking, and home-lab workflows.

Connects Koris to the **Coredash** personal assistant dashboard using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) over Streamable HTTP (`/api/mcp`).

Once connected, Koris discovers all tools exposed by the Coredash server and makes them available to the agent with the `coredash__<tool>` prefix. Configuration is managed via environment variables (`COREDASH_MCP_URL`, `COREDASH_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN`) or in `plugins/mcps/coredash/config.yml`.

MCP servers are disabled by default. Enable via the admin dashboard Plugins panel or `/mcps enable coredash` in trusted chat.

configFields.name: url
configFields.label: Server URL
configFields.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint URL of the Coredash MCP server.

configFields.name: bearer_token
configFields.label: Bearer Token
configFields.description: Optional authentication token for the MCP server.

pt-br.name: Coredash MCP
pt-br.summary: Conecte o Koris ao servidor MCP Coredash via Streamable HTTP para ferramentas de dashboard pessoal.
pt-br.description:
O [CoreDash](https://github.com/guilhermesalviano/coredash) é um painel pessoal leve e auto-hospedado para automação pessoal, monitoramento de sistema, acompanhamento de hábitos e fluxos de home-lab.

Conecta o Koris ao dashboard de assistente pessoal **Coredash** usando o Model Context Protocol (MCP) via Streamable HTTP (`/api/mcp`).

Uma vez conectado, o Koris descobre todas as ferramentas expostas pelo servidor Coredash e as disponibiliza para o agente com o prefixo `coredash__<tool>`. A configuração é gerenciada por variáveis de ambiente (`COREDASH_MCP_URL`, `COREDASH_MCP_BEARER_TOKEN`) ou em `plugins/mcps/coredash/config.yml`.

Servidores MCP ficam desativados por padrão. Ative pelo painel de Plugins no dashboard admin ou via `/mcps enable coredash` no chat confiável.
